concerns.text: No task produces the consolidated metrics artifact required by the metrics contract. metrics.schema.yaml (a Phase-1 plan element) mandates one object with correlation_results per level, statistical_tests (incl. bonferroni_corrected_p), latency_reduction, and collinearity_check; tasks scatter these into test_metrics.json, t_test_results.json, latency_metrics.json, final_consistency_summary.json, and dataset_diagnostics.json with different field names. The contract is orphaned — add a task (or extend T013) to emit a schema-conforming metrics.json.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs plan.md:Project Tasks T019, data-model.md:GapPredictor.feature_names
concerns.text: Plan element T019 'Feature Extraction & PCA' and the data model's feature_names ["PCA1","PCA2"] have no covering task: T006 trains KRR directly on raw gradient_norm/local_curvature with no PCA step, so predictor.schema.yaml's feature_names expectation cannot be satisfied as documented. Either add a PCA task or the plan/data-model must be revised.

FR-006 requires a paired t-test of 'policy acceptance rates AND final scores', but T009's t-test consumes only reasoning scores; acceptance_rate_proxy/acceptance_rate_sync are recorded but never statistically compared. Half of FR-006 has no covering task.

Plan task IDs T015–T032 have no traceable match in tasks.md (T001–T013, different decomposition). Scientific content is largely covered by description, but plan elements T023 (Stratify), T029 (Full Hardware Sync Baseline), T031 (Generalizability) etc. cannot be traced by ID. Add a mapping (e.g., in the coverage section) from plan task IDs to the new task IDs.

T001's unit tests claim to verify 'schema conformance' against training_sample.schema.yaml, but that contract's required list (kl_div_int4/int8/fp8, timestamp) references fields absent from its own properties block with additionalProperties:false — the tests cannot pass against the contract as written. T001 should note the contract defect or the contract must be fixed.

SC-005's n ≥ 300 total-sample floor is not enforced by any task: T004's early-stop rule ('stop early only if >300 samples done') and ≥100-per-level check do not verify the total n ≥ 300 constraint is maintained when dataset size is reduced for the 6-hour budget.
